Jongno-gu.name: Jongno-gu
Jongno-gu.description: Historic heart of Seoul with traditional palaces, temples, and cultural heritage sites. Known for traditional Korean architecture and historic landmarks dating back centuries.
Jongno-gu.attractions: Ancient palaces, traditional tea houses, art galleries, antique shops

Jung-gu.name: Jung-gu
Jung-gu.description: Downtown Seoul blending modern skyscrapers with traditional markets and cultural landmarks. The commercial and cultural heart of the city.
Jung-gu.attractions: Shopping malls, traditional markets, historic palaces, museums

Yongsan-gu.name: Yongsan-gu
Yongsan-gu.description: Vibrant district with international atmosphere, trendy shops, restaurants, and cultural venues. Popular with expats and young professionals.
Yongsan-gu.attractions: International restaurants, boutique shops, electronic markets, cultural museums

Seongdong-gu.name: Seongdong-gu
Seongdong-gu.description: Emerging arts and culture district with modern galleries, design studios, and hip cafes along the Han River.
Seongdong-gu.attractions: Art galleries, design studios, trendy cafes, riverside parks

Gwangjin-gu.name: Gwangjin-gu
Gwangjin-gu.description: Entertainment and leisure district with theme parks, shopping centers, and recreational facilities.
Gwangjin-gu.attractions: Theme parks, water parks, entertainment venues, shopping malls

Dongdaemun-gu.name: Dongdaemun-gu
Dongdaemun-gu.description: Major shopping and fashion hub featuring both modern malls and traditional wholesale markets. Center of Seoul's fashion industry.
Dongdaemun-gu.attractions: Fashion markets, design complex, historic gates, shopping streets

Jungnang-gu.name: Jungnang-gu
Jungnang-gu.description: Residential area northeast of downtown with parks, natural scenery, and cultural spaces along the Jungnang Stream.
Jungnang-gu.attractions: Parks, nature trails, recreational facilities, cultural centers

Seongbuk-gu.name: Seongbuk-gu
Seongbuk-gu.description: Cultural and artistic district with universities, temples, and parks. Strong artistic community with galleries and cultural events.
Seongbuk-gu.attractions: Art galleries, temples, parks, student-friendly cafes, cultural venues

Gangbuk-gu.name: Gangbuk-gu
Gangbuk-gu.description: Northern district blessed with natural beauty, featuring Bukhansan National Park and mountain hiking trails.
Gangbuk-gu.attractions: National parks, hiking trails, temples, mountain scenery

Dobong-gu.name: Dobong-gu
Dobong-gu.description: Mountain-rich area with abundant nature trails, parks, and outdoor recreation facilities. Popular with hikers and nature enthusiasts.
Dobong-gu.attractions: Mountains, valleys, parks, hiking trails, outdoor activities

Nowon-gu.name: Nowon-gu
Nowon-gu.description: Peaceful residential district with shopping malls, parks, and sports facilities. Family-friendly neighborhood.
Nowon-gu.attractions: Parks, sports facilities, shopping malls, taekwondo venues

Eunpyeong-gu.name: Eunpyeong-gu
Eunpyeong-gu.description: District blending traditional and modern elements with historic hanok villages and contemporary cultural centers.
Eunpyeong-gu.attractions: Traditional hanok houses, mountain trails, cultural centers, village cafes

Seodaemun-gu.name: Seodaemun-gu
Seodaemun-gu.description: Historical district with important cultural landmarks, universities, and parks. Rich in Korean independence movement history.
Seodaemun-gu.attractions: Historic museums, universities, parks, memorial sites

Mapo-gu.name: Mapo-gu
Mapo-gu.description: Trendy district with vibrant nightlife, international restaurants, cafes, and riverside attractions. Popular with young professionals.
Mapo-gu.attractions: Bars, restaurants, cafes, river parks, university district

Yangcheon-gu.name: Yangcheon-gu
Yangcheon-gu.description: Quiet, family-friendly residential area with shopping centers, parks, and river activities.
Yangcheon-gu.attractions: Shopping malls, parks, sports facilities, residential areas

Gangseo-gu.name: Gangseo-gu
Gangseo-gu.description: Western district with direct access to Incheon International Airport and extensive han river parks.
Gangseo-gu.attractions: River parks, airport facilities, recreational areas, nature paths

Guro-gu.name: Guro-gu
Guro-gu.description: Industrial and commercial district with modern business complexes and digital technology hubs.
Guro-gu.attractions: Tech companies, business centers, industrial parks, modern facilities

Geumcheon-gu.name: Geumcheon-gu
Geumcheon-gu.description: Industrial zone with business and manufacturing areas, gradually transforming with modern commercial development.
Geumcheon-gu.attractions: Industrial complexes, business areas, parks, educational institutions

Yeongdeungpo-gu.name: Yeongdeungpo-gu
Yeongdeungpo-gu.description: Financial and commercial center with riverside attractions, modern skyscrapers, and shopping complexes.
Yeongdeungpo-gu.attractions: Skyscrapers, parks, shopping malls, financial institutions, observation decks

Dongjak-gu.name: Dongjak-gu
Dongjak-gu.description: Cultural and governmental district south of Han River with museums, parks, and important administrative buildings.
Dongjak-gu.attractions: Government buildings, museums, cultural centers, parks

Gwanak-gu.name: Gwanak-gu
Gwanak-gu.description: University district with vibrant student culture, mountain scenery, and student-friendly cafes and restaurants.
Gwanak-gu.attractions: University campus, mountains, parks, student-friendly venues

Seocho-gu.name: Seocho-gu
Seocho-gu.description: Wealthy residential area with upscale shopping, fine dining, and prestigious cultural institutions.
Seocho-gu.attractions: Luxury shops, fine dining, cultural centers, parks, art galleries

Gangnam-gu.name: Gangnam-gu
Gangnam-gu.description: Most prestigious district known for luxury brands, high-end restaurants, nightlife, and trendy entertainment venues.
Gangnam-gu.attractions: Designer stores, restaurants, nightclubs, parks, cultural venues

Songpa-gu.name: Songpa-gu
Songpa-gu.description: Modern residential district with Olympic facilities, theme parks, and family-friendly entertainment.
Songpa-gu.attractions: Theme parks, sports complexes, parks, modern residences, shopping

Gangdong-gu.name: Gangdong-gu
Gangdong-gu.description: Eastern residential area with parks, cultural venues, and river activities. Peaceful neighborhood with natural charm.
Gangdong-gu.attractions: Parks, river areas, cultural venues, recreational facilities
